native_startup_assessment.scope: Own same-candidate hardware pilot submission-to-container-start intervals; includes admission; not calibrated future startup or success assurance

cost_semantics: Cumulative latency cost: sum of qualification Job latencies, study elapsed (including confirmation/planning/control), and each main API lifecycle latency. Overlapping F0 queue waits are conservatively counted per Job; this is not end-to-end experiment wall time. Reservation uses native scheduled-to-finished duration. Historical image/fixture construction and energy are unmeasured.
